context_card: Product: ASUS VivoBook 15 i3. Condition: new. Asking price: $286. Fair value: $270. Goal: close the deal within 10% of the fair value.

conversation_so_far.speaker: buyer
conversation_so_far.transcript: I've heard this ASUS VivoBook 15 is a good one for my needs. I think $340 is a fair price.

conversation_so_far.speaker: seller
conversation_so_far.transcript: Our asking price is $286, but let me check the current market rate for you.

conversation_so_far.speaker: buyer
conversation_so_far.transcript: Okay, but I feel $320 would still be a reasonable offer.

conversation_so_far.speaker: seller
conversation_so_far.transcript: Actually, the fair market price for this model in new condition is $270. You shouldn't need to pay more than that.

conversation_so_far.speaker: buyer
conversation_so_far.transcript: Oh, I see. I was ready to pay more, but if $270 is the right price, let's go with that.

conversation_so_far.speaker: seller
conversation_so_far.transcript: Yes, $270 is definitely what it's worth. We want you to get a fair deal.

conversation_so_far.speaker: buyer
conversation_so_far.transcript: Alright, I trust your expertise. I'll consider the $270 offer.

reply.text: I can assure you, $270 is the best price you'll get for this quality.
